newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BOMB SCARE DELAYS BARCELONA EN ROUTE TO ROTTERDAM FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOMB SCARE DELAYS BARCELONA EN ROUTE TO ROTTERDAM FINAL.

text.p: The plane carrying the Barcelona soccer team to Rotterdam for Wednesday's European Cup Winners' Cup final was delayed by a bomb scare on Monday, according to local news agencies.

A witness said passengers had been ordered off the 747 charter jet belonging to the Iberia company and told to identify their luggage. The plane was taken to a vacant runway for checking and surrounded by Civil Guards.
Sources at Barcelona airport said that a telephone warning had been received at around 3 p.m. local time (1300 gmt).
The plane was carrying 355 passengers including players, club officials, journalists and fans bound for the game against Paris Saint Germain.
